messages:
Sam H: Quick sync: we're doing a base-image rebuild that switches to a key-rotation-friendly KMS alias and surfaces a new audit attribute 'kms_key_fingerprint' on container start. Proposed rollout: canary tonight 23:00 PT, full roll tomorrow morning. Need to confirm RBAC for runtime service accounts and update the log schema mapping. Any blockers?

Vivian L: Adding new audit field is fine as long as it's backwards compatible. Make it optional for the first 12h, then require. Also we should bump the index template in ES so it doesn't create a bunch of dynamic fields.

Ash K: I'll validate RBAC and Workload Identity mappings. Heads-up: cosign signer service will change its key alias; image verification agents will need permission to get the public key. We should keep old key as fallback for 6 hours.

Maria S: I'll prepare the IAM PR for the new decrypt/verify bindings and include a terraform plan. Also opening an infra ticket to extend audit retention by 48h in case of spike.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment: image-rebuild:v4-canary deployed to staging-eu. 3 pods running, 1 failed (CrashLoopBackoff).

Ash K: Investigating the crashloop. Looks like a missing file permission in the init container when mounting /etc/cosign. Error: permission denied reading keyring. Likely the nodepool annotation for the GSA binding is absent.

Maria S: I'll add the annotation to the affected nodepool and reapply binding. Linking my PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/482. Tagging @Ash K for review.

Vivian L: Observability: please add a mapping in the logshipper for kms_key_fingerprint and add an index alias shift to avoid reindexing. I'll also add suppression for schema-mismatch alerts for the first 8h of rollout.

sec-oncall: I'll monitor startup error rates. Rule: if >0.5% of pods fail with kms_key_* related errors for 15m, we abort and roll back. Also watch for audit pipeline error spikes.

Sam H: Plan: 1) Maria lands IAM binding + nodepool annotation. 2) Ash verifies staging canaries pass with old-key fallback. 3) Canary to prod small pool (2 pods) with opt-in flag. 4) Wait 30m, check alerts/logs. 5) Flip opt-in after 24h. I'll post follow-up once canary completes. :white_check_mark:
